description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pirivena, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521008
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names, and title classifications. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
